name: skillsaw-lint
description: Use when modifying agentic contextual building blocks like skills (SKILL.md), slash commands, agents, hooks, plugins, marketplaces, and instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, Cursor, Copilot, Cline, or Kiro rules), tool configuration such as an OpenCode `opencode.json`, Muse Code hooks (`.muse/hooks.json`), a Grok Build `.grok/` project layer, a ZCode `.zcode/` project layer or `.zcode-plugin/` plugin, or a Google Antigravity customization root (`.agents/`, `.agent/`, `_agents/`, `_agent/` — hooks, MCP config, rules, registries and plugins), and committed project memory (`.agents/memory/`). Run skillsaw on the files you touched, apply autofixes, resolve remaining violations with `skillsaw explain` guidance, and re-lint until clean before considering the work complete.

findings.excerpt: with `uvx skillsaw==<version>` as the prefix for every command below (or
`pip install skillsaw==<version>` if uvx is unavailable).
